shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' | head -80 && printf '\\n--- root ---\\n' && ls -la && printf '\\n--- git ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- instructions ---\\n' && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- ignore ---\\n' && cat .gitignore && printf '\\n--- dependency summary ---\\n' && ls node_modules | head -70 && printf '\\n--- tracked files ---\\n' && git ls-files && printf '\\n--- recent history ---\\n' && git log -3 --oneline"
/bin/bash -c "node --version && npm --version && command -v apply_patch && printf '\\n--- nested guidance ---\\n' && find /workspace -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print"

/bin/bash -c "set -eu
base=http://localhost:43127
printf 'Home: '; curl -s -o /tmp/margins-home.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' \""'$base/"
printf '"'Stylesheet: '; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}\\n' \""'$base/styles.css"
printf '"'Create: '; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\\n' -d 'title=The+Secret+History&author=Donna+Tartt&notes=A+beautiful+%26+haunting+book.' \""'$base/books"
book_id=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('"'fs').readFileSync('/tmp/margins-smoke-books.json'))[0].id)\")
printf 'Detail: '; curl -s -o /tmp/margins-detail.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' \""'$base/books/$book_id"
printf '"'Finished: '; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\\n' -X POST \""'$base/books/$book_id/finish"
printf '"'Missing: '; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' \""'$base/books/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
printf '"'Validation: '; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' -d 'title=&author=Someone' \""'$base/books"
printf '"'\\nSaved JSON:\\n'; cat /tmp/margins-smoke-books.json
printf '\\nExpected text on detail: '; rg -o 'A beautiful & haunting book\\.' /tmp/margins-detail.html"

/bin/bash -c "printf 'Browser binaries: '; command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || true
printf 'Screenshot tools: '; ls node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer' || true
printf 'Status: '; git status --short
printf 'Broken internal paths? '; rg -o 'href=\"/["'^"]*"|action="/[''^"]*"'"' server.js | sort -u | head -30"

/bin/bash -c 'kill 295 BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/margins-smoke-books.json PORT=43127 node server.js >/tmp/margins-server.log 2>&1 & server_pid=$! trap '"'kill \""'$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true'"' EXIT sleep 1 base=http://localhost:43127 printf 'Persisted book after restart: '; curl -s \""'$base/" | rg -o '"'The Secret History' | head -1 printf 'Persisted finished status: '; curl -s \""'$base/" | rg -o '"'1 finished' | head -1 printf 'Invalid form preserves notes: '; curl -s -d 'title=&author=Someone¬es=Keep+this+thought' \""'$base/books" | rg -o '"'Keep this thought' | head -1 printf 'Escaped user input: '; curl -s -d 'title=%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C%2Fscript%3E&author=A%26B¬es=%3Cb%3Ebold%3C%2Fb%3E' \""'$base/books" -D /tmp/margins-headers -o /dev/null; detail_path=$(awk '"'tolower("'$1)=="location:" { print $2 }'"' /tmp/margins-headers | tr -d '\\r'); curl -s \""'$base$detail_path" | rg -o '"'<script>alert\\(1\\)</script>|A&B|<b>bold</b>' | sort -u printf 'Raw script tags on detail: '; curl -s \""'$base$detail_path" | rg -c '"'' || true printf 'Saved count: '; node -e \"console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/margins-smoke-books.json')).length)\""

/bin/bash -c "git diff --check && node --input-type=module -e \"import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import postcss from 'postcss'; const root = postcss.parse(readFileSync('public/styles.css', 'utf8')); console.log('CSS parsed:', root.nodes.length, 'top-level rules');\" && printf '\\nChanged files:\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\nDefault data file:\\n' && cat data/books.json && printf '\\nProcesses on smoke-test port:\\n' && (ps -eo pid,args | rg '[n]ode server.js' || true)"
